title: Dolch Second Grade Worksheets | 2nd Reading Practice Pack with Answer Key
desc:
📚 Common Core aligned: RF.2.3f, RF.2.4

Give your learners extra practice with Dolch Second Grade! This no-prep printable pack has 5 practice pages plus a 1-page answer key for grown-ups. Just print and go.

WHAT'S INSIDE (8 pages)

  • Cover page
  • Dolch Second Grade: Find the Word
  • Dolch Second Grade: Spelled Right?
  • Dolch Second Grade: Memory
  • Dolch Second Grade: Sentences
  • Dolch Second Grade: Phrases
  • Answer key (1 page): every answer, plus "Say" lines for listening pages
  • Terms of use

PERFECT FOR

  • Morning work, centers and small groups
  • Homework, early finishers and review
  • Homeschool lessons and summer practice

WHY TEACHERS LOVE IT

  • Clear directions young learners can follow
  • Friendly pictures that match each word
  • Listening pages keep the words in the answer key, so children truly listen
  • Each page matches a game on Creative Sprout Learning (Dolch Second Grade: Find the Word, Dolch Second Grade: Spelled Right?, Dolch Second Grade: Memory, Dolch Second Grade: Sentences, Dolch Second Grade: Phrases), so children can play, then print and practice

💰 SAVE MORE: this pack is part of the Phonics & Reading Bundle and the Mega Bundle.
